_comment: Repo doc -> Confluence page. Every entry here is RE-PUBLISHED by
_tools/confluence/sync-published-docs.sh on each deploy, so a published runbook cannot
silently drift from the tree it documents.
To add a doc: publish it once with `publish-solution.py publish <md> --parent <id> --title
<title>`, then record the returned page id here. Do NOT hand-edit pageId to point somewhere
else; that would overwrite an unrelated page on the next deploy.

docs.title: Running a Tournament
docs.why: The only operator-facing instructions for running an event. Confluence had zero pages matching 'tournament' before this.
